analogy.rationale: Lipase inhibitors target DAGL/FAAH-related lipid signaling and cannabinoid receptor pathways, but most listed targets (pancreatic/gastric lipase, hormone-sensitive lipase) are not expressed in these cell lines, so responses should be weak; the closest analogs are other lipid-signaling/cannabinoid classes.
